segments.name: Americas
segments.description: Designs, distributes and retails lululemon branded apparel, footwear and accessories across the Americas through stores, e-commerce, wholesale and other channels.
segments.evidence: We report three segments, Americas, China Mainland, and Rest of World, which is comprised of the APAC and EMEA regions on a combined basis.

segments.name: China Mainland
segments.description: Sells lululemon branded apparel, footwear and accessories in China Mainland through company-operated stores, a WeChat store and third-party online marketplaces.
segments.evidence: We operate lululemon branded retail locations in China Mainland in a variety of different formats including different sizes of company-operated stores, outlets, pop-ups, and other temporary locations.

segments.name: Rest of World
segments.description: Sells lululemon branded apparel, footwear and accessories across APAC and EMEA through company-operated stores, licensed locations, websites and online marketplaces.
segments.evidence: We report three segments, Americas, China Mainland, and Rest of World, which is comprised of the APAC and EMEA regions on a combined basis.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay the company for lululemon branded apparel, footwear and accessories sold through company-operated stores, e-commerce, outlets, wholesale partners, licensees and the Like New re-commerce program.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate net revenue in the Americas through our lululemon branded retail locations which include different sizes of company-operated stores, outlets, pop-ups, and other temporary locations.

changes.text: In 2024, the company acquired the lululemon branded retail locations and operations in Mexico previously run by a third-party licensee, allocated to the Americas segment.
changes.evidence: On September 10, 2024, we acquired the lululemon branded retail locations and operations in Mexico previously run by a third-party licensee.
